French, German bond yields widen amid economic concerns

The spread on French 10-year government bonds compared to German bonds has reached its highest point since 2012. Concurrently, German mortgage rates have climbed to their highest level since 2009. These developments indicate increasing economic pressures and differing financial market conditions between the two major European economies.
